reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). OLX Partner API v2 (developer.olx.ua): register an app with an OLX account; post/manage own adverts, messaging, categories/cities; no public search of all listings.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://developer.olx.ua/api/doc): OLX Partner API v2 (developer.olx.ua): register an app with an OLX account; post/manage own adverts, messaging, categories/cities; no public search of all listings. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
